description: This file is an HTML document that contains embedded JavaScript and forms for editing Smarty template language code, and includes references to JavaScript source files for the CodeMirror editor with Smarty mode. It serves as an interface for editing and configuring Smarty templates within the CodeMirror editor environment.

methods.name: CodeMirror.fromTextArea
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror editor instance on a specified textarea element with given configuration options.
